Programs

Five names for sessions we are preparing.

Discover, Build, Innovate, Compete, and Advance are ways to talk about the work. Ages below are guidance so a family can see where a child might begin. They overlap, and they are not a test.

Not open yet. There is no schedule, no price, and no registration for any of these. If you want to hear when a session is real, get session updates. That list is not a seat in a class and not team placement.

Access

Access is the way in: a workshop, a school, or another host in the community. It is not a sixth class with its own age rule. It is how a family finds Discover, Build, or whatever fits.

Cost is part of access. Shared equipment, sponsored places, volunteer mentors, and grants are how AfroBot plans to keep a start within reach. Our goal is an entry workshop around $10. That amount is a goal, not a current price.

Ask about financial assistance. Please do not send financial documents.

Suggested ages are guidance. They overlap. They are not a test. Where a competition sets eligibility, that rule wins.

Suggested ages 5–8

Discover

Playful building and simple machines, with an adult close by.

Suggested ages 9–12

Build

A longer project: design something, make it, and test it with a team.

Suggested ages 12–15

Innovate

Harder problems, including how AI tools are used and how a team explains its choices.

Eligibility set by the competition

Compete

AfroBot aims to prepare students for established competitions such as FIRST Tech Challenge. AfroBot is not affiliated with FIRST. Joining the interest list is not team placement.

Competition stance

Suggested ages 15–18

Advance

Practice and guidance toward further learning. AfroBot does not guarantee college admission, scholarships, or credit.

University pathways

Tell us how you want to take part.

This form is for adults. Parents and guardians, community leaders, mentors, and partners can write. A student takes part through a parent or guardian. We use this only to reply about AfroBot.

Fields marked *with an asterisk are required.

  • If you are under 18, ask a parent or guardian to submit this form.
  • Do not include a child’s full date of birth, school ID, or anything meant for a public profile.
  • Do not send financial documents, tax forms, or account numbers.
  • The interest list is not team placement.
